get.description: Redirects to the URL associated with the given link ID. This is the public shortlink endpoint.

parameters.name: sig
parameters.description: Click signature for verified click tracking

get.description: Returns a paginated list of links. Can be filtered by user.

parameters.name: client_type
parameters.description: Filter by client platform (e.g., irc, slack, discord)

parameters.name: client_channel
parameters.description: Filter by client channel (requires client_type and client_network)

200.description: List of links with pagination metadata

post.description: Submits a new link. Links are always created even if the URL was previously submitted. Duplicate information is included in the response. When client fields (client_type, client_network, client_channel) are provided, duplicate detection is scoped per client: a URL is only considered a duplicate if it was previously submitted from the same client.

201.description: Link created successfully. If duplicate detection finds a prior submission (scoped per client when client fields are provided), the response includes is_duplicate=true and previous_submissions. Returns 208 instead when the link is an exact duplicate within the same client scope.

422.description: Validation error (invalid URL or missing fields)

get.description: Returns a single link by ID.

delete.description: Deletes a link by ID. Requires API key authentication.

get.description: Returns a paginated list of quotes.

parameters.name: client_type
parameters.description: Filter by client platform (e.g., irc, slack, discord)

parameters.name: client_channel
parameters.description: Filter by client channel (requires client_type and client_network)

200.description: List of quotes with pagination metadata

post.description: Submits a new quote. Only the quote text is required.

get.description: Returns a single quote by ID.

delete.description: Deletes a quote by ID. Requires API key authentication.

get.description: Returns all tags associated with a link.

post.description: Adds tags to a link. Authorized if admin API key is present, or if within 10 minutes of link creation and username matches the original poster.

put.description: Replaces all tags on a link. Same authorization rules as POST.

delete.description: Removes a specific tag from a link. Requires admin API key.

404.description: Tag not found on this resource

get.description: Returns all tags associated with a quote.

post.description: Adds tags to a quote. Authorized if admin API key is present, or if within 10 minutes of quote creation and username matches the original author.

put.description: Replaces all tags on a quote. Same authorization rules as POST.

delete.description: Removes a specific tag from a quote. Requires admin API key.

404.description: Tag not found on this resource

get.description: Returns site-wide statistics and a leaderboard of users by activity.

parameters.name: offset
parameters.description: Number of leaderboard entries to skip (default: 0)

get.description: Returns statistics for a specific user.
Search links and quotes by keyword. Minimum 4 characters required.

parameters.name: type
parameters.description: Content types to search (comma-separated: links, quotes). Defaults to both.

parameters.name: offset
parameters.description: Number of results to skip per type (default: 0)

parameters.name: client_type
parameters.description: Filter by client platform (e.g., irc, slack, discord)

parameters.name: client_channel
parameters.description: Filter by client channel (requires client_type and client_network)

put.description: Deletes the existing cached preview for a URL and re-fetches it. Specify the link by ID or URL.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Link ID to refresh the cached preview for

parameters.name: url
parameters.description: URL to refresh the cached preview for

404.description: Link not found (when using id parameter)

delete.description: Clears the link preview cache. Can clear all entries or a specific URL.

parameters.name: url
parameters.description: Specific URL to clear from cache. If omitted, clears all cache.

get.description: Returns today's kitten without triggering a fetch.

put.description: Fetches a new kitten if one doesn't exist for today. Returns the existing kitten if one already exists.

fetched.description: True if a new kitten was fetched, false if one already existed

delete.description: Removes today's kitten. Use this to remove an undesirable kitten, then PUT to fetch a new one.

get.description: Fetches OpenGraph metadata for a URL. Returns cached data if available, otherwise fetches fresh metadata. Supports special handling for YouTube, Reddit, Twitter, Flickr, and OEmbed providers.

parameters.name: url
parameters.description: The URL to fetch OpenGraph metadata for

status.description: HTTP status code from fetching the URL

404.description: Could not fetch preview for the URL
